outcome: Missing original-requirement fields return clarifying questions to the customer MKT dialog, the customer can submit structured follow-up answers there, and a record is tracked only after customer confirm

the customer can submit a structured follow-up answer for a named field without using the developer shell

the original-requirement draft stays untracked until the customer confirms

a follow-up answer that includes technical design is rejected and does not update the draft
a product question posted from Agent Channel appears in the customer MKT dialog
customers can list open questions and answer them on their own project
inScope: customer MKT dialog questions and confirm
assumptions: intake sessions and customer chat already exist
original-requirement.write already requires quotes, goal, and confirmed
